items.detail: Ladies Night Out: Harvest & Holiday A Mt. Prospect Parks Foundation Fundraiser! Gather friends and RELAX while you enjoy a beautiful and breathtaking flower presentation by Mary from Lake Zurich Florist. Your registration includes a glass of wine and charcuterie/sweet treats along with the chance to win one of six fresh centerpieces created right before your eyes! items.detail: Holiday Hunt Sixth annual holiday hunt! Start your holiday break by plunging into RecPlex Pool for three dive sessions per time slot. Prizes will be given for collecting “ornaments” in the pool. Our beach going Grinch will be making a special appearance for photo opportunities in his cave. items.detail: Mt. Prospect Fitness Dri-Tri Welcome to the Dry Triathlon, no water required! Row 2,000 meters, air bike 2.5 miles, and run 1 mile on the track. Participants complete each segment consecutively, with total time recorded by staff. Each participant will be assigned a designated heat time before the event. Heats begin every 30 minutes, starting at 8:00 AM and running through 11:30 AM, with four participants per heat. Assigned heat times cannot be adjusted. Every triathlete receives an event shirt and refreshments! R $35 NR $45 Registration begins Monday, November 2 Click here to register!
items.title: Mt. Prospect Fitness Dri-Tri

items.detail: Free Healthy Lecture Series Topic: The Gift of Letting Go A one-hour lecture focused on the connection between fitness, wellness, and the power of letting go. Discover how releasing stress, unhealthy habits, and unrealistic expectations can improve your physical and mental well-being. Learn practical strategies to embrace balance, build healthier habits, and create a more positive, sustainable approach to living a healthier life. Registration begins Monday, November 2 Click here to register!
items.title: Free Healthy Lecture Series

items.detail: Ladies Night Out: Big Game Bites and Valentine Delights Football and romance share center stage on Sunday, February 14! Enjoy a culinary presentation and tasting by Chef Susan Maddox. Susan has over 30 years of experience gained from country clubs, corporations, and restaurants. This live presentation includes two game day appetizers and two desserts. Susan will explain all methods and techniques involved in preparing the recipes. Gather your friends and learn something new to impress everyone at this year’s Super Bowl Party or Valentine Dinner! Light snacks and soft drinks will be served. Your registration includes the chance to win one of a dozen “perfect for entertaining” raffle prizes! Instructor Chef Susan Maddox Friendship Park Conservatory Ages 21+ Fee $35 Registration begins Monday, November 2 Click here to register!
items.title: Ladies Night Out: Big Games Bites and Valentine Delights

items.detail: Seed Swap Celebrate National Seed Swap day at Friendship Park Conservatory’s annual Seed Swap. Participants will have the opportunity to take home seeds from a variety of annuals, vegetables, herbs and native perennials supplied by Friendship Park Conservatory and the community. Donations of seeds for this event are highly encouraged, as it is, after all, a swap! Seed may be dropped off at FPC the week leading up to the event or on the day. Note: Seed must be labeled with the variety, category (annual, vegetable, etc) and the date of collection. Members of the Mt. Prospect, Des Plaines and Arlington Heights Garden Clubs get in for FREE but must call to register. Seed donations are NOT required for participation! R $3 NR $5 Registration begins Monday, November 2 Click here to register!
items.title: Seed Swap
